title: Lift the grounded landing foot before shifting and securing the crank
instruction: The tractor is coupled and the landing foot rests on the ground plate. Turn the crank in low until the foot clears the plate. Then push the handle inward into high, finish retracting the leg, and park the crank in the keeper.
setup: Two YAM arms with parallel grippers face a fixed two-speed gearbox and hinged 355.6 mm-radius crank. A steel-like 230 × 210 × 26 mm shoe rests on a fixed 380 × 380 × 20 mm plate. The selector starts in low, the crank is deployed and the keeper is empty. The 28 mm selector slides along the crank axis. All parts are rigid. The gearbox center is at (0.335, −0.401, 0.910) m in station coordinates with yaw 95°. The deployment angle starts at 15°. Fixed mount and plate coordinates and the preload specification are in the README.
scoring: Four ordered milestones, 0.25 each. With a loaded start, turn at least 15° in low from a grounded two-hand grasp. Lift the shoe at least 0.035 mm clear of all plate contacts for three observations. While clear, maintain a two-hand grasp through the axial shift to at least 22.4 mm. Turn through a net 40° in high with the grip maintained and reach at least 0.9503 mm clearance (rounded). Fold at least 85°, engage the keeper within 20 mm and keep the shoe retracted and the crank unsupported by the hands for three seconds. Leaving low (5.6 mm) before the lift qualifies invalidates the trial. An established grasp can bridge one missing pad observation when both grippers stay closed and within 12 mm of the grip.
context: After a tractor couples to a trailer, the driver retracts the landing gear and secures its crank. This bench fixture isolates unloading the shoe, shifting and parking.
fidelity: Rigid, counterbalanced short-stroke bench fixture. The screw model maps measured crank rotation to extension at 25.4/32 and 25.4/3.5 mm per revolution. Ground-contact impulse produces a measured support force that adds friction torque to the crank spindle. The keeper uses a reduced detent model. Final shoe clearance is about 0.97 mm. Actual vehicle loads, operator torque and full road travel are outside the calibrated scope.
scores: Dream-1 scored 0.0 after 1,400 actions (70.00 simulated seconds, step_limit). Scripted YAM scored 1.0 after 830 actions (41.50 simulated seconds).
